# Parley v0.1.53

Four changes decided and built on 14 September 2026: the launch review reads
as one form, every vendor can run in a container, the pane menu no longer
lists vendors, and a workspace may be empty.

## The launch review

The permission review now opens with **Runs**, a choice between On this
machine and In a container, and ends with two lists in place of the earlier
Vendor Enforcement, Always Outside the Profile and host-disclosure sections.
**What is carried** names each thing the launch passes and who keeps it: the
vendor for folders, profile, approvals and Codex's network rule, Docker for a
container's mounts, and nobody for a container bypass. **What is not carried**
states that operating-system enforcement stays the vendor's, which execution
or network rules no launch argument carries, what is always outside a
profile, and that attribution is not isolation on this machine. Every line is
derived from the launch plan, whose parts are now exposed alongside the joined
text the checks already pin.

## Container panes for Agy and Copilot

Any agent pane can run in a person-reviewed local container. Agy needs
nothing beyond its executable at `/usr/local/bin/agy`; Copilot at
`/usr/local/bin/copilot` also receives its instructions directory as the one
environment key a container launch may carry. Bypass vendor permissions
passes Agy the same skip-all flag as Claude and Copilot its documented
`--allow-all`; any allow-all flag arriving as a vendor argument is refused.
Team approval offers container settings for every allowed vendor.

The image probe's temporary home now allows executables and has room,
because Copilot's launcher unpacks about 150 MB with a native addon into its
cache on first start.

**A bug in every image built from the documentation.** Docker copies the
image's directory at a volume mount point, ownership included, into a
still-empty volume on every create. The home initializer chowns the volume
and leaves it empty, so the pane's own create copied root ownership back and
the vendor could not write its home. Both home mounts now carry
`volume-nocopy=true`, two checks pin it, and `docs/container-images.md`
explains it. The v0.1.27 spike image escaped the bug only because it had no
`/home/parley` directory. `docs/parley-agents.Dockerfile` is the exact recipe
of the four-vendor test image this release was verified against; the three
Docker spikes pass on it for all four vendors.

Sign-in inside a container for Agy (Google OAuth, paste the code back) and
Copilot (folder trust, then its device code) reached their prompts and were
not completed; they are yours to verify, as are instruction uptake and login
persistence.

## Pane menu: Shell and Agent

The toolbar's Pane menu offers **Shell** and **Agent**, each with the same
six split-and-folder items, instead of one entry per vendor. A shell opens
at once. Agent opens the review, now titled New Agent Pane, whose **Vendor**
row is where Claude Code, Codex, Agy or Copilot is chosen; changing it
re-derives the remembered profile default, the approvals text, the container
wording and both lists, and discards a checked image. The row preselects the
last vendor you started. **Pane › New Agent Pane…** on Option-Command-N does
the same, and the New Claude, Codex, Agy and Copilot Pane items keep their
shortcuts and open the same review with their vendor preselected. Restart,
resume and folder access have no Vendor row.

## Empty workspaces

**New Workspace** creates no pane. The empty state offers New Shell and New
Agent…, and the workspace's attachments, New Pane Folder and history are
usable before any pane exists. Closing a workspace's last pane leaves the
workspace in place; closing the workspace stays explicit, and the last
workspace cannot close. Moving the last pane out is allowed and empties the
source. A saved workbench with workspaces and no panes reloads as it was;
only one with no workspaces counts as a fresh install. A fresh install and
Open Folder still seed one shell, because those gestures ask for a place to
work.

## Verification

All 364 native checks and both repository scans pass. New checks cover the
launch plan's parts, the Help wording for every change, the four-vendor
container projection, the environment allowlist and allow-all guard, the
nocopy mounts, the Shell and Agent menu routing to the preselected vendor,
and the empty-workspace rules including reload. Hand-verified in the
Development app: every state of the review, container panes for Agy and
Copilot to their first prompts, the vendor row and the remembered vendor,
and an empty workspace through close, quit and relaunch. Unnotarized beta,
as before.
